description: What to see and do at one place, as its page's "Things to do" says it: five to seven sights, the ones most read about first (how often each one's Wikipedia article is read), each with one line in Wikivoyage's words, or Wikidata's description, and the article it is quoted from. Then the page's one row of tours and tickets: the things-to-do sites people in the reader's own country use, each opened on the place, with no dates; some pay TravelCharika a commission, which never decides whether or where one is listed; show the result's disclosure with the links, and mark the ones that pay (`paid`) as "Ad". Given a month, that month's verdict and its page. A place under travel advice is answered with the advice first, as its page shows it. Not opening hours, prices or a day-by-day plan.

from_city.description: One of TravelCharika's departure cities, by its airport code ("DEL", "LON") or its name ("Delhi", "London", "Bombay"). Optional: the city the trip starts from, which gives the reader's country where reader_country is left out.

month.description: A month: 1 to 12, or its name ("December", "dec"). Optional: that month's verdict, and its page.

place.description: A place TravelCharika covers: its id from search_places ("bali") or its name ("Bali", "Da Nang", "Ubud").

reader_country.description: Where the reader lives, as a two-letter ISO 3166 code ("GB", "IN") or an English name: whose sites to list. Taken from from_city when left out.

name: things_to_do
title: Things to do
